response.reason: The kernel correctly fuses four 1D binomial steps per axis into a single 9-tap convolution with coefficients binom(8,k)/256, and handles the per-step zero boundary via the standard odd (antisymmetric) extension about the ghost lines at -1 and N (period 2(N+1)), which keeps ghost values zero at every intermediate step so the fused result matches the finite-domain iteration. Horizontal and vertical passes commute, so fusing all 4 horizontal then 4 vertical steps per 2D-step group (and repeating for steps=8 in FP32) preserves the target well within the 2e-5 tolerance.
